description: Frozen eight-building external holdout for the second pre-CSS architecture experiment. Selected by metadata only before any drawing raster was downloaded or OCR was run; 27 master sheets total, approximately 24.7 MiB according to LOC API byte metadata, spanning seven states and four building types.

buildings.selection_reason: Two-sheet Appalachian cabin survey; compact regional transfer case.
Four-sheet Texas log-cabin survey; tests a larger cabin record without reusing the v1 corpus.
Two-sheet bunk-cabin survey; tests a non-domestic cabin program.
Six-sheet Missouri barn survey; tests an agricultural envelope with a small master-byte footprint.
Four-sheet Montana gambrel dairy barn; tests roof-topology transfer beyond simple cabin gables.
Two-sheet Pennsylvania farmhouse survey; compact eastern farmhouse transfer case.
Two-sheet Texas tenant-farmhouse survey; compact southern farmhouse transfer case.
Five-sheet Virginia detached-house survey; tests a small urban house without row-house aggregation.
